text:
Silver Price in 1994
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1994, the LBMA silver price fell 4.1% between 1994-01-31 ($5.06) and 1994-12-30 ($4.85). The highest sampled price was $5.74 in March and the lowest was $4.85 in December. The mean of these observations was $5.30. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
